title: Ask, Never Demand: The First Asking

texts.details:
You have your first totems. You think that makes you a shaman. It makes you someone who has been lent something.

Hear how our people lost this. On the world we came from, the orcs were shaman, all of us. Then we were turned against the draenei, and we slaughtered them, and the spirits looked at what we had done and went silent. So our shaman took a power that did not need asking for. Warlocks. You know where that road ended.

The Warchief brought the old way back. It can be lost again.

Something has roused a spirit of the dust in the hills north-west of here. Go to it. It will strike at you. Do not hate it for that. Stand, and let its anger wear out against you.
texts.objectives: Wear out the anger of the Roused Spirit of Dust, in the dry hills north-west of Razor Hill, then return to your teacher.
texts.progress: You cannot kill a spirit. You can only outlast its anger.
texts.completion:
It is quiet? Good. It is not dead; a spirit of the land does not die. It has gone back into the ground, and it will remember that you stood and did not curse it.

That is the whole rule, $N, and I will say it once. A shaman asks. A shaman never demands. The elements are not servants and they are not all kind. They lend, and they can stop lending.

The world is full of those who demanded instead. I want you to see what became of each. Take one of these. When you have twenty seasons, find Kardris Dreamseeker in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.

idea: Ask, Never Demand, level 10 (Horde): one roused spirit near home, and the rule that a shaman asks. Invented: the spirit.
